mapper.select: SELECT item_id AS itemId, seller_id AS sellerId, seller_nickname AS sellerNickname, title, description, start_price AS startPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, end_time AS endTime, status FROM auction_items WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT item_id AS itemId, seller_id AS sellerId, seller_nickname AS sellerNickname, title, description, start_price AS startPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, end_time AS endTime, status FROM auction_items WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auction_items (seller_id, seller_nickname, title, description, start_price, current_price, end_time, status) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{sellerNickname}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{endTime}, #{status})
